name: Phoenix 凤凰 799 700C carbon electric-assist road bike
why_interesting: The retained 700C card bridges to the Phoenix 799 carbon electric-assist family. Its 6 Ah and 10 Ah battery options remain unresolved at the selected-card level.

facts.complete_weight_basis: Current exact-family retailer specification lists vehicle quality as 20 kg; size, selected 6 Ah or 10 Ah battery, pedals, accessories and measurement method are not stated.
facts.drivetrain: 9-speed transmission; component maker, model and gearing range are not published.
facts.frame_material: Retailer-described T700 carbon-fiber frame; fork material and lay-up details are not published.

missing: Selected 6 Ah or 10 Ah battery option, exact motor model, assist controls, and complete component identities
Maximum tire clearance and meaningful stiffness evidence
source_note: The current exact-family retailer page identifies Phoenix model 799 with a carbon frame, 9-speed transmission, 20 kg listed vehicle weight and separate 36 V 6 Ah / 10 Ah choices. The retained card establishes the 700C China-market presentation but does not expose which battery option was selected.
